name: CENTURIA 16

specs.notes: Mansory's Centuria kit is carbon bodywork and aero only: the Chiron underneath is stock. The 8.0 W16 with four turbochargers: 1,500 PS (1,103 kW) at 6,700 rpm and 1,600 Nm from 2,000 to 6,000 rpm; 7-speed dual-clutch, all-wheel drive; 2,711 mm wheelbase; 420 km/h (limited); 0-100 km/h 2.4-2.5 s (Bugatti; auto motor und sport's data). Weight: 1,995 kg dry of a driver (2,070 kg EU kerb with one); the carbon kit's saving isn't published. The gear ratios aren't published: spread for the top speed. 43 % front, the drag and downforce are estimates.

garage.blurb: Sixteen cylinders, four turbos, 1,500 horsepower and a tuner's forged-carbon armour. Nothing in the garage pulls harder from 200.

interior.notes: The model's: carbon and turquoise trim, its wheel (cut out by part); a dual-clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
